title: Technical Manager - Zendesk ( 6 months contractual role)
description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a high\-impact Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the strategy, evolution, and technical stability of our Customer Experience (CX) ecosystem. Having completed a migration from Salesforce to Zendesk Enterprise, we are now building a proactive, automated, high\-efficiency CRM.
   

  

 In this role, you will serve as the "Enterprise Systems \& AI Product Owner." You will lead a team of two Zendesk Specialists, collaborate directly with enterprise clients to scope API integrations, and drive cross\-functional engineering projects. You will be responsible for turning Zendesk into an AI\-enabled workspace—deploying Zendesk Copilot, AI Agents for deflection, Zendesk AutoQA, Zendesk WFM, Glean Enterprise Search, and Gemini LLM integrations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic AI Ecosystem \& Native Zendesk Optimization**
* Autonomous AI Deflection: Build, optimize, and oversee Zendesk AI Agents (Bots) to increase self\-service resolution rates for Tier\-1 inquiries.
* Agent Copilot \& Productivity: Architect and fine\-tune Zendesk Copilot (Auto\-Assist workflows, real\-time ticket summarization, and suggested next actions) to reduce Average Handle Time (AHT) and cognitive load.
* 100% Automated Quality Governance: Established Zendesk AutoQA scorecards and automated grading logic to continuously evaluate 100% of human and bot interactions, using sentiment analysis to flag churn risks and coaching opportunities.
* Workforce Management (WFM): Oversee Zendesk WFM (Tymeshift) configuration to transition from reactive staffing to data\-driven, predictive capacity planning.


**Platform Architecture \& Tool Integrations (Glean / Gemini)**
* Enterprise AI \& Search Readiness: Partner with engineering and data teams to connect enterprise search tools (Glean) directly into Zendesk so agents can search across Confluence, Drive, and internal tools from a single workspace.
* Gemini LLM Workflows: Build data pipelines and API hooks to connect Gemini/LLMs for predictive retention modeling, automated drafts, and custom object field enrichment.
* Internal Tool Middleware: Oversee integrations between Zendesk, internal ERPs, product databases, and middleware (e.g., Webhooks) to create a single 360\-degree CRM workspace.


**Customer API Discovery \& Developer Experience**
* External Client Solutions: Interface directly with strategic business clients and account executives to gather technical requirements for direct API access, custom webhooks, and dedicated customer portal integrations.
* Developer Experience: Partner with internal software engineers to maintain clean, secure, rate\-managed, and well\-documented Zendesk REST APIs for customer usage.


**Governance, Stability \& Knowledge Architecture**
* Environment Governance: Establish strict Sandbox\-to\-Production release pipelines, manage API rate limits, audit trigger loops, and ensure compliance (GDPR/Data Privacy).
* Knowledge Architecture (KCS): Lead a Knowledge\-Centered Service strategy to consolidate company\-wide documentation into a structured source of truth indexed within Zendesk.
* Team Leadership: Directly manage and mentor 2 Zendesk Specialists, managing sprint planning, task prioritization, and platform issue triage.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years in Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, or CX Platform Ownership.
* Zendesk Enterprise Mastery: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex Zendesk instances, including Sandbox environments, Custom Objects, Omnichannel Routing, Copilot, AI Agents (Bots), AutoQA, and WFM.
* Integration \& API Technical Depth: Proven experience with REST APIs, Webhooks, JSON, OAuth, Postman, and middleware integration tools (Workato, Zapier, n8n).
* AI \& Search Engines: Hands\-on experience or technical project delivery involving Enterprise Search (e.g., Glean, Coveo) and LLMs (e.g., Google Gemini, OpenAI).
* Client Engagement: Ability to run discovery meetings directly with tech teams to translate business needs into clear technical specifications.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Zendesk Certified Systems Architect.
* Demonstrated track record implementing Knowledge\-Centered Service (KCS) principles across multi\-department teams.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

 About Us

Our culture is built on the principles of fun, friendliness, and family, making us one of the most admired workplaces in the world.

**Job Summary**
* Serve as the liaison between the business (represented by the Product Owner) and the Agile software development team. Help the team reach peak productivity by working with team members, resolving impediments blocking a team, and helping to track their progress. Play a critical role in the adoption of Scrum and other Agile development practices by the organization.
* As a Scrum Master \- MarTech / Content Supply Chain, you’ll enable a high\-performing delivery pod by establishing disciplined Scrum practices, improving flow and predictability, and creating an operating rhythm that helps teams deliver transformative MarTech and digital experiences.
* You’ll coach teams through purposeful ceremonies, remove impediments, strengthen collaboration across Product, Engineering, QA, and dependent teams, and use delivery metrics and feedback loops to drive continuous improvement. The role will also support Agile delivery for AI\-enabled and agentic capabilities, where experimentation, evaluation thresholds, probabilistic outputs, and human escalation paths influence planning and incremental delivery.


**Responsibilities**
* Organize and facilitate planning, daily stand\-up meetings, reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, demos and other Scrum\-related meetings
* Serve as the team’s radiator, ensuring necessary internal and external communication, while improving overall transparency
* Ensure the development teams are practicing the core Agile values, practices and principles of collaboration, prioritization, team accountability, and visibility
* Look for avenues to increase the productivity effectiveness of the teams in any way possible
* Assist team with making appropriate commitments through story selection, task definition
* Add value to the team and organization and coach the team up
* May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders
* Establish and facilitate effective Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, and other team operating rhythms.
* Coach the pod on Scrum principles, Agile practices, ownership, accountability, estimation, and continuous improvement while protecting the team from avoidable delivery disruption.
* Improve delivery predictability by monitoring and using velocity, WIP, throughput, cycle time, predictability, and other flow metrics to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Identify, surface, track, and remove impediments that affect team delivery, coordinating with Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, Platform, and dependent teams as needed.
* Create an environment where team members own commitments, decisions, and outcomes while constructively resolving conflicts and improving team collaboration.
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to support backlog readiness, story clarity, acceptance criteria, sprint goals, sequencing, and realistic delivery commitments.
* Support delivery of AI\-enabled and agentic capabilities by helping teams incorporate experimentation, evaluation metrics, probabilistic outputs, human\-review or escalation points, and learning loops into iterative delivery.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple pods, shared platform teams, and Agile Release Trains, making commitments, risks, dependencies, and release readiness visible to stakeholders.
* Use Jira or Azure DevOps to create and maintain dashboards that make flow, dependencies, commitments, release readiness, and continuous\-improvement actions visible.
* Facilitate retrospectives that result in specific, owned actions and follow through on improvement commitments to strengthen team health and delivery performance.
* Partner with distributed US/India teams and cross\-functional stakeholders to maintain clear communication, operating rhythms, and handoffs across the delivery ecosystem.
* Coach teams through change and support the establishment of a high\-performance Agile culture within new or evolving MarTech delivery pods.


**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Ability to demonstrate capacity in airport/airline operations, airport finances, contracts, and high regard for interpersonal relationships
* Ability to produce working contracts among different stakeholders such as definition of done, scope lock, acceptance of work etc.
* Skilled in strong organization and communication
* Skilled in utilizing strong problem\-solving in an unstructured environment as a self\-starter
* Skilled in planning, preparing for, and leading meetings
* Ability to demonstrate and maintain an extremely high regard for confidential and sensitive information
* Skilled in SAFe
* Deep practical command of Scrum and Agile delivery, including sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, estimation, and impediment removal.
* Strong experience coaching software or platform delivery teams and improving team ownership, collaboration, accountability, and delivery discipline.
* Strong understanding of flow and delivery metrics including velocity, WIP, throughput, predictability, cycle time, and retrospective action tracking.
* Ability to facilitate difficult conversations, resolve delivery and team conflicts, and build alignment across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and dependent teams.
* Strong delivery\-tooling skills with Jira or Azure DevOps, including dashboards and reporting for flow, dependencies, commitments, release readiness, and improvement actions.
* Ability to support scaled Agile delivery across multiple pods, shared platforms, and Agile Release Trains while making dependencies and risks visible.
* Ability to coach teams delivering AI\-enabled or agentic products where probabilistic outputs, experimentation, evaluation thresholds, and human escalation paths affect planning and acceptance.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills with the ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
* Strong problem\-solving and systems\-thinking skills with a focus on sustainable delivery improvements rather than short\-term process compliance.


 Education
   

  

* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field and/or equivalent formal training


**Experience**
* Required: Intermediate\-level experience, fully functioning broad knowledge in:
+ Scrum framework and Kanban methods

title: Senior Test Analyst, AI
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose\-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
   

  

**Overview** 
  

  

 The Senior AI Test Analyst is responsible for defining, implementing, and executing testing strategies for AI\-powered solutions, including AI agents, generative AI applications, machine learning models, APIs, and business process workflows. The role focuses on AI model validation, data quality assessment, performance testing, responsible AI compliance, and the automation of testing processes to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, secure, and high\-quality AI solutions.
   

 As MUFG Retirement Solutions continues to embed AI across its technology landscape, this role plays a key part in driving the adoption of AI\-enabled testing practices and automation capabilities. The position is responsible for identifying innovative and cost\-effective solutions, leveraging AI to enhance testing efficiency, quality, and coverage while promoting industry best practices.
   

 The role also ensures that the AI testing and automation strategy aligns with business objectives, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and the broader technology vision of MUFG Retirement Solutions.
   

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities** 
  

 Strategic Focus 
   

* Develop and execute testing strategies for AI, Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, performance, and business value.
* Define and implement robust AI test frameworks, methodologies, and automation solutions covering functional, integration, API, system, end\-to\-end, model validation, data validation, prompt validation, and adversarial testing scenarios.
* Establish comprehensive validation processes for AI model outputs against business requirements, acceptance criteria, Responsible AI principles, regulatory standards, and organizational governance policies.
* Drive quality assurance across the complete AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, inference, monitoring, retraining, and reporting.
* Assess AI solution performance across dimensions such as accuracy, relevance, consistency, explainability, fairness, robustness, and reliability.
* Integrate AI testing activities and test automation framework \& scripts with continuous integration, CI/CD pipelines and tools to support continuous testing and deployment of AI solutions.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and project managers to define testing requirements, success criteria, and quality measures.
* Manage the execution of automated test suites, monitor the test results and collaborate with teams to troubleshoot and resolve the issues promptly.
* Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, and quality risk management activities, ensuring timely resolution of issues impacting AI model performance and business outcomes.
* Champion the adoption of AI\-enabled testing tools, intelligent automation techniques, synthetic test data generation, and predictive quality engineering practices to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Drive research and evaluation of emerging AI testing methodologies, LLM evaluation frameworks, model benchmarking techniques, automation technologies, and industry best practices, providing strategic recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Establish and govern enterprise standards, processes, controls, and best practices for AI testing, validation, Responsible AI compliance, and model quality assurance across multiple AI initiatives.


  

 Operational Management
   

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test scripts for AI, ML, and Generative AI applications.
* Validate data quality, data integrity, and data lineage across AI systems and supporting platforms.
* Lead functional, integration, API, regression, user acceptance, and end\-to\-end testing of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Assess AI model outputs for accuracy, consistency, bias, hallucinations, explainability, fairness, and alignment with business requirements and responsible AI standards.
* Execute prompt testing, response validation, and scenario\-based testing for Generative AI solutions.
* Execute model validation and inference testing activities, ensuring AI solutions perform consistently across diverse datasets, use cases, and operating conditions.
* Monitor and analyse test execution results, quality metrics, and model performance indicators, producing actionable insights and comprehensive test reports for stakeholders.
* Identify, document, track, and drive resolution of defects, model performance issues, data quality concerns, and AI\-specific risks throughout the testing lifecycle.
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high\-quality AI solutions.
* Support test data preparation, environment validation, and model release verification activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance AI testing frameworks, processes, and automation capabilities.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to project teams on AI testing methodologies, Responsible AI validation, test automation approaches, and emerging industry practices.
* Mentor junior testers and contribute to building AI testing capabilities across teams through coaching, standards adoption, and continuous learning initiatives.


  

 Governance \& Risk
   

* Identify quality, model, data, security, privacy, ethical, and compliance risks associated with AI solutions and proactively support mitigation activities.
* Validate adherence to Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and governance standards.
* Conduct and support the assessment and reporting of AI\-related risks, including model bias, explainability, fairness, and data quality concerns.
* Maintain appropriate test evidence, validation reports, defect records, and audit documentation to support governance and compliance requirements.
* Escalate risks, issues, and control gaps that may impact AI solution quality, regulatory compliance, or business outcomes.

* Strong experience in designing, developing, and executing AI\-powered test automation frameworks and quality assurance solutions using tools such as Selenium, Appium, UFT/OpenText (at least one mandatory), Python, Maven, Postman, REST APIs, SoapUI, Cortex, and Snowflake.

 The Position
   

  

 Technology Consultant Learning Operations Expert
   

  

**Introduction** 
 As a Technology Consultant at the SE6 level within RDT Performance \& Insights, you will take on a matrix leadership role to deliver on a diversity of high\-impact products and multi\-faceted projects. You will lead both internal and external teams or squads in a matrix organization, developing advanced approaches like Agile backlog management, and driving the timeline and strategy across product teams. **The Opportunity:**
* Lead Matrix Squads \& Deliveries: Lead internal, external, and unofficial teams across matrix organizations to successfully deliver on a wide diversity of high\-impact products and learning operations projects
* Architect Agile Timelines: Develop and implement advanced operational approaches—such as Agile backlog management—defining clear delivery timelines and priorities across product teams and squads
* Manage Enterprise Backlogs: Prioritize, plan, and report execution status at the multi\-product, enterprise, or product\-line level to ensure alignment with business objectives
* Solve Complex Technical Challenges: Conduct root\-cause analysis and problem\-solving for unusually complex issues, proposing highly innovative solutions and process improvements
* Influence Product Line Strategies: Shape product and product\-line strategies by applying in\-depth industry trends, advanced data analysis, and technical principles for maximum value creation

* Foster Collaborative Environments: Lead cross\-product collaborative team environments and champion organizational development initiatives, such as showing active leadership in Communities of Practice (CoPs)


**Who you are:**
* Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field
* Experienced Technology Consultant: You bring 5\+ years of consultancy experience, including 3\+ years of specialized experience in life sciences/pharma or the assigned business function being supported
* Consultancy Domain Expert: You possess advanced knowledge of consultancy concepts and practices, with deep expertise in at least one primary consultancy capability and business process domain knowledge
* Technical \& Process Analyst: You demonstrate strong capabilities in applying advanced technical principles, theories, and concepts related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis
* Complex Problem Solver: You have a proven track record of working on multi\-faceted projects and successfully resolving unusually complex problems with innovative technical solutions
* Enterprise Stakeholder Manager: You bring exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate enterprise\-level portfolios and tailor messaging to diverse audiences
* Mentoring \& Agile Leader: You possess a demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues, provide constructive feedback, lead matrix teams, and drive organizational development initiatives (e.g., CoPs)


**Why Join Us?**
* Remuneration: Competitive base salary paired with an attractive performance incentive scheme
* Security: Premium health insurance covering you and your family, alongside a high\-matching Provident Fund
* Well\-being: Flexible working arrangements, generous annual leave, and global professional growth opportunities


**Call to Action:**
 Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.
   

  

 \#RDT2026
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit

 The role involves mentoring and guiding engineers, proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks, and facilitating effective communication between engineering and other stakeholders. The manager oversees deployment processes across AWS infrastructure, monitors system performance, and provides decisive technical leadership during incidents. Ultimately, this role aims to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and innovation in MCO software development practices.

**Agile \& Team Leadership:**
* Own the effectiveness of the Scrum Agile process and adherence to good agile practices for the team.
* Be responsible for the quality of the teams’ outputs and the customer experience of our products.
* Lead product development teams through all stages of the SDLC, from requirements gathering through production deployment on AWS.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative engineering culture focused on delivering high\-quality software products.
* Mentor and coach engineers to foster their technical growth and career development, with emphasis on modern JavaScript/TypeScript best practices.


**Technical Leadership – MEAN Stack \& AWS:**
* Hands\-on participation in all technical activities including architecture and design reviews, code reviews, coding, troubleshooting, and defect triage across the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js).
* Define and enforce coding standards and best practices within the engineering team for TypeScript/JavaScript, Angular component architecture, RESTful API design, and Node.js services.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure high code quality and adherence to engineering standards across the full stack.
* Oversee MongoDB Atlas configuration, schema design, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, and data migration processes.
* Drive architecture decisions for AWS services including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, and related infrastructure.
* Identify technical risks and challenges early in the project lifecycle and propose mitigation strategies, particularly around scalability, security, and cloud cost optimisation.


**Delivery \& Operations:**
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate product requirements into technical specifications.
* Drive automation in the engineering teams, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and automated testing.
* Drive continuous improvement in development processes and tools to increase efficiency and quality.
* Act as a technical liaison between engineering, product management, and other stakeholders.

* Oversee deployment and release processes using AWS\-based CI/CD to ensure smooth and reliable product launches.
